title: Fortune Auto 350Z (True style rear)
description:
The Fortune Auto 500 Series Coilovers (True Style Rear) for the 2003–2008 Nissan 350Z (Z33) and Infiniti G35 convert the factory OEM separate rear spring/bucket setup into a full, true rear coilover layout. This eliminates the heavy factory rear spring buckets, allowing the use of aftermarket toe arms and delivering precise suspension articulation. Hand-assembled and dyno-tested in Richmond, Virginia, the Generation 8 series utilizes High Flow Digressive Piston Technology to maintain supreme driver control without sacrificing daily ride comfort.

Key Features & Specs:

• Chassis Fitment: 2003–2008 Nissan 350Z (Z33) / 2003–2007 Infiniti G35 Coupe & Sedan (True Rear Conversion)• Rear Layout: True Coilover Setup (Replaces OEM separate spring/shock configuration)• Default Spring Rates: 10k Front / 8k Rear• Damping Adjustment: 24-Step Rebound Adjustable Dampers with FA Synthetic Shock Oil• Digressive Technology: Billet High Flow Digressive Pistons for maximum damper sensitivity• Construction: Monotube damper with high-pressure nitrogen gas & T6 6061 bright dip anodized aluminum mounts• Bearings: Radial bearing mounts standard for smooth steering and noise-free operation• Modularity: Fully rebuildable, revalveable, and upgradeable to 2-Way or 3-Way external canister setups• Warranty: 5-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty
